# PptxGenJS 4.0.1

Browser bundle copied unchanged from the npm package `pptxgenjs@4.0.1` using
`npm pack`, with npm package integrity verification enabled. MIT license in
`LICENSE`. The bundle includes JSZip. Upstream: https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS

Loaded locally, on demand, by `causerie-export.js`. No CDN or runtime package
installation is required. Updating the dependency must preserve its license
and rerun the presentation content and browser tests.
